enablement: Explicit --enable-sync and Helm sync.enabled=true; default remains disabled

panel.witnessFetchAuthorization: Separate file-backed bearer, constant-time comparison and administratively fixed view allowlist; cannot read wrappers, stage, index or mutate values
panel.identities: Immutable realm/project/environment/view/log UUIDs mapped to an existing complete environment
panel.readerAuthorization: Live machine identity, current owner policy, explicit view grant and full environment read permission; no partial-view ciphertext filtering
panel.immutability: Hash-addressed canonical signed envelopes; index derived from a fresh independently verified witness head
panel.keyBoundary: Panel stores ciphertext and publisher-signed reader wrappers, never receives the E2E2 read key or publisher private key
panel.legacy: E2E2 environments reject legacy reads/writes and legacy emergency export; no implicit E2E1 or plaintext migration
panel.sealedPanel: Existing unseal guard remains required for machine envelope/wrapper reads; restart recovery may require an administrator to unseal the panel

witness.initialization: Offline independently signed genesis with exact administrative genesis hash and public-key pins; no runtime registration/reset API
witness.authority: Full journal replay under per-log interprocess lock; O_EXCL CAS append, file and directory fsync before acceptance proof
witness.separation: Deployment requirement: separate signing key and volume excluded from panel/operator restore domain; separate development volumes alone do not prove production restore independence
witness.headProof: Fresh 32-byte nonce, exact scope, canonical floor, sequence/hash and pinned witness epoch/key
witness.commit: Exact expected head CAS and independently validated publisher-signed envelope; response alone is not a trusted checkpoint
witness.failClosed: Missing/torn/gapped journal, bad genesis/signatures/links, stale CAS, unsupported authority transition or replay capacity exceeded

checkpoint.container: Administratively precreated mutable Opaque Kubernetes Secret with pinned UID; no automatic create/reset
order: verify two live independently signed witness proofs and complete envelope/wrapper
persist accepted high-watermark using resourceVersion CAS
revalidate and confirm exact durable head
write complete target data with target UID/resourceVersion checks
checkpoint.failure: Read/verification failures do not mutate the target. Retain the highest durably accepted checkpoint, which may advance before a target write fails; never roll it back. Mark DataCurrent=false and preserve last-success metadata. An ambiguous target write requires reconciliation or administrative repair, never a stale cached fallback
checkpoint.creationCrashWindow: Crash after target creation but before target UID registration becomes StateAmbiguous; explicit administrative repair required
checkpoint.concurrencyBoundary: No atomic transaction across CR, Store, state and target; instantaneous revocation and HA fencing are not claimed

target.namespace: One installation namespace and administratively allowlisted Secret names
target.ownership: Never adopt an existing target by labels/revision; exact CR/Store/target UIDs must match durable state
target.selection: Whole verified view first, then All/Keys selection and path-prefix filtering; required keys, duplicate keys, size and empty-target checks
target.revision: Random opaque 128-bit value only when actual data changes; equal plaintext may advance checkpoint without changing data revision
target.deletionPolicy: Retain has no owner reference; Delete uses exact SekvyrSecret controller owner reference and Kubernetes garbage collection; operator has no delete permission
target.rolloutIntent: eligible=false in stage 4; no workload patch or restart execution
target.status: Child observedGeneration plus observedStoreUID/observedStoreGeneration prevent aggregate success from an older authorization; DataCurrent is independent of rollout readiness

transport: HTTPS only, administrator-pinned origins/CAs, no redirects or environment proxy, bounded bodies/headers/timeouts, projected token reread for each login, fixed same-origin bearer routes, safe public reason codes
remainingStages: Stage 5: controlled optional application rollout tied to accepted data revision
Stage 6: production ledger independence, restore, authority/key transitions and HA fencing
Stage 7: broader Kubernetes/storage compatibility and operational acceptance
Stage 8: independent security review, migration, UI and signed release
